# Independent Sector

> Independent Sector is the leading membership organization and advocacy hub for the nonprofit sector, providing research, policy engagement, and community building for 1,600+ member organizations.

Independent Sector serves as a vital convening body for nonprofits, foundations, and corporate partners, advancing civil society through research on sector health, trust, workforce issues, and civic engagement. The organization publishes influential national studies on volunteer valuation, nonprofit financial security, governance, and advocacy impact.

## Key Topics

- Nonprofit sector health and trends
- Nonprofit advocacy and civic engagement
- Trust in nonprofits and philanthropy
- Volunteer time valuation
- Nonprofit workforce and financial security
- Board governance and leadership
- Civil society and democracy strengthening
- Nonprofit coalition building
- Policy engagement and action
- Nonprofit state-level data
- Membership and community programs
- National Summit
- Research and data analytics
- Leadership awards and recognition
- Nonprofit capacity building

## Core Organization

- [Independent Sector - A Vital Meeting Ground](https://independentsector.org): Homepage for Independent Sector nonprofit membership organization and advocacy hub
- [Advocate | Independent Sector Action Center](https://independentsector.org/policy/take-action): Action Center for nonprofit advocacy and policy engagement with policymakers
- [Community | Building Trusted Relationships | Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/community): Community hub for 1,600+ member nonprofits with summits and fellowship programs
- [Nonprofit Coalition Connection - Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/community/nonprofit-coalition-connection): Interactive tool for coalition building and nationwide nonprofit network connection

## Research & Data

- [Research on the Nonprofit Sector](https://independentsector.org/research): Research hub featuring nonprofit sector health, trust, and workforce studies
- [Trust in Nonprofits and Philanthropy 2025 | Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/resource/trust-in-civil-society): 2025 trust survey showing nonprofit sector trust outpaces government and business
- [Nonprofit Advocacy & Civic Engagement Research - Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/nonprofit-advocacy-civic-engagement-research): Landmark research on nonprofit advocacy influence and civic engagement trends
- [Value of Volunteer Time - Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/research/value-of-volunteer-time): Annual national volunteer hour valuation report with state-by-state analysis
- [Financial Insecurity in the Nonprofit Workforce - Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/research/financial-insecurity-in-the-nonprofit-workforce): Research on financial hardship affecting over 1 in 5 nonprofit employees
- [Nonprofit State Profiles - Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/nonprofit-state-profiles): Interactive dashboard with state-level nonprofit sector data and economic impact

## Nonprofit Leadership & Governance

- [Principles for Good Governance | Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/research/principles-for-good-governance): Governance guidelines and best practices for nonprofit board management
- [Earning Influence - Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/resource/earning-influence): Recommendations for increasing nonprofit advocacy capacity and civic engagement
- [Strategic Volunteer Engagement Program - Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/research/strategic-volunteer-engagement-program): Strategic volunteer engagement toolkit and research for nonprofit capacity building
- [Preserving Civil Society - Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/community/preserving-civil-society): Content on civil society, democracy strengthening, and nonprofit sector independence

## Research Methodology & Resources

- [Value of Volunteer Time: Methodology | Independent Sector Resources](https://independentsector.org/research/value-of-volunteer-time-methodology): Methodology documentation for volunteer time valuation calculations

- [Contact Us | Independent Sector](https://independentsector.org/contact): Contact information for membership, media, and general inquiries
